//: custom_apps ↔ apps/ mirrors the bind mount in compose.yaml. Bring the stack up with `make up-dev`, then start this listener and send a request carrying the Xdebug trigger (XDEBUG_TRIGGER cookie/GET, or the browser Xdebug helper). To debug Nextcloud core instead, add a mapping like "/var/www/html": "<path to a checked-out NC 34 source tree>".
